item.title: Waka-sama no Zasuru Sekai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Minato Carnival
  • 発売日: 2019-04-26
  • スコア: 7.69/10 (167 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 和香様の座する世界
  • 英語名: Waka-sama no Zasuru Sekai

あらすじ

Umezono Ryouga inherits his late grandfather’s Shinto shrine, having nowhere else to go and no relatives left alive to stay with. There, he accidentally summons and unseals a goddess which nearly eats him alive. Fortunately, he is able to get out of it by offering to cook and buy said goddess Waka-sama all the delicious food that the little money he earns from his part-time job can buy. Brimming with curiousity, Waka-sama ventures out into modern Japan with Ryouga, looking for her sister and discovering new foods, sights, spirits, monsters, and gods all the while.

あらすじ

This Fandisc was created to celebrate Minato Carnival’s 5th Anniversary. There are new characters and scenarios for both the Tsujidou-san and Anegin series.

–Tsujidou-san Jun’ai Road New Episode–

It’s 2013, a year after Hiroshi met Ai Tsujidou and spent time with other delinquets during a turbulent summer.

There had been rumors that an unindentifed person was hunting delinquets in Shonan, the city where Maki graduated which seemed to be peaceful.

item.description:

  • 日本語名: 姉小路直子と銀色の死神
  • 英語名: Anekouji Naoko to Gin’iro no Shinigami

あらすじ

New eroge written by Ou Jackson and Takahiro.

The baby-faced Shinkurou is loved by those who are older than him. His older sister Naoko says that she doesn’t want to spoil him, but that’s basically what she does. She was determined to make him a proper adult. However, the Finnish transfer student Kirsti, also known as the “Silver God of Death”, took an interest in him, which further worried Naoko. His surroundings quickly descended into a riot…

item.title: Tsujidou-san no Jun'ai Road
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Minato Carnival
  • 発売日: 2012-09-28
  • スコア: 7.69/10 (2006 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 辻堂さんの純愛ロード
  • 英語名: Tsujidou-san no Jun’ai Road

别名

  • Tsujidou-sans Pure Love Road

あらすじ

Hiroshi was a student at Inamura Academy in Kanagawa Shounan and became interested in his delinquent classmate Tsujidou-san after seeing her help a kitty in the rain. But everyone around her are also delinquents, including her rivals Maki and Renna. The life of an ordinary guy like him just got a lot more troubled!
